summary: Iteration 12: Tested three changes to Chullz poker. (1) Inline assignment on main table - confirmed implemented in /app/web/src/pages/PokerTable.tsx with confirm-assignment-btn data-testid. (2) Omaha engine rules - all hand evaluation tests pass (flush requires 2 hole cards of same suit, high-card descriptor uses player's hole card). (3) Backend /api/tables routes still work after game_engine changes. All 20 backend tests PASS. Frontend code confirmed correct by review + UI tests.

inline_assignment_button.detail: confirm-assignment-btn data-testid exists at line 982 of /app/web/src/pages/PokerTable.tsx. Inline section at lines 957-994 renders inside main game view (not separate screen). AssignmentPanel only imported as TYPE (line 7), never rendered.

no_separate_assignment_screen.detail: The old `round === 'assignment' ? <AssignmentPanel /> : <gameView>` pattern is GONE. Now assignment confirm section is inside the main game view flex container. Verified via grep - no AssignmentPanel JSX element in PokerTable.tsx.

confirmed_waiting_state.detail: Lines 970-975 show '✓ Confirmed — waiting for others…' when submitting=true OR gameState.assigned_uids.includes(user.id).

drag_to_swap_hole_cards.detail: handleCardDragStart/Drop/Over/Tap at lines 568-585. Drag-and-drop swap on HTML5 drag events. Tap-to-select-and-swap also works. BOARD_LABELS shows B1/B1/B2/B2/B3/B3 under each pair. Works on assignment round since holeCards are shown when round !== 'waiting'.

submitInlineAssignment.detail: submitInlineAssignment() at lines 520-528 derives assignment from holeCardOrder and calls handleSubmitAssignment. Pre-assignment auto-set at lines 482-490 when round changes to 'assignment'.

omaha_flush_6_high.detail: best_hand_omaha(['6d','4d'], ['Jd','Td','Kd','Qd','9d']) = 'Flush, 6 high'. _desc5_omaha uses hole_vals_sorted[0] (the player's highest hole card) for flush 'high' label.

omaha_no_flush_one_diamond.detail: best_hand_omaha(['6d','4s'], ['Jd','Td','Kd','Qd','9h']) = NOT a flush. Enforced because must use BOTH hole cards (6d+4s): 4s breaks the flush suit requirement.

omaha_pair_of_aces.detail: best_hand_omaha(['Ah','9s'], ['As','Kh','Qh','2d','5c']) = 'Pair of Aces'. Standard label used for pair hands.

omaha_high_card_9.detail: best_hand_omaha(['9s','7h'], ['Ad','Kh','Qd','2s','3c']) = 'High Card 9'. Uses hole card's highest value (9) not community's ace.

standard_labels_unchanged.detail: Two pair: 'Two Pair, ...', Full house: 'Full House, ...', Four of a kind: 'Four of a Kind, ...', Straight: 'Straight, N high' all use standard labels.

api_tables_routes.detail: GET /api/tables, POST /api/tables/create, POST /api/tables/join, GET /api/tables/{id} all return 200 with valid data.

login_and_lobby.detail: Profile selection → PIN entry → lobby navigation works. Table creation modal shows, table is created and navigated to.

critical_code_review_comments: IMPORTANT: /app/frontend/app/poker-table.tsx (Expo/React Native version) still has the OLD code with AssignmentPanel rendered for assignment round. However, this file is NOT served to users - the web app at /app/web/src/pages/PokerTable.tsx is what's deployed. The Expo version is a separate codebase not in production.
board labels BOARD_LABELS in PokerTable.tsx is defined as ['B1','B1','B2','B2','B3','B3'] (line 610) - correctly maps positions to boards.
Straight Flush case in _desc5_omaha: uses hole_high for 'high' descriptor - this may be controversial for straigh flushes where the straight rank matters more, but matches the specification.
handEvaluator.ts in /app/web/src/utils/ is the frontend-side hand evaluator - should be checked for consistency with backend Omaha rules if used for live previews during assignment.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all features verified by code review + playwright)

rca_of_improvements.omaha_engine: _desc5_omaha() new function takes hole_cards param and uses hole_vals_sorted[0] for 'high' label in flush and high-card hands. best_hand_omaha() enforces exactly 2 hole + 3 community via combinations(community,3) loop, ensuring only valid Omaha hands are evaluated.
rca_of_improvements.inline_assignment: Old code: round==='assignment' ? <AssignmentPanel /> : <gameView>. New code: gameView is always shown; a sub-section inside gameView shows the confirm button when round==='assignment'. AssignmentPanel is now only imported as a type for the Assignment interface.
